description:
Inner Stillness Music | Slow Tanpura Drone | 1.5 Hours

Some moments you don't need music to feel something. You just need a sound to drop attention into.

This is for those moments. Not sleep, not active relaxation, not a meditation guided by anyone — just a tonal anchor with nothing to follow. The mind has nothing to chase, no melodic phrase to anticipate, no rhythm to count. And in the absence of all those things, the noise inside has nowhere left to go.

This is 90 minutes of pure solo Tanpura drone. The Tanpura is the Indian drone instrument — four long strings tuned to a root key, plucked in a slow cyclic pattern, with the characteristic jawari buzz that creates a rich resonant overtone wash. There's no melody. There's no raga in the usual sense — just the continuous tonal center, vibrating into the room like the inside of a deep bell.

Sit upright with it for meditation, lie down with it to drop in, or have it underneath you as you sit quietly and do nothing.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Tanpura — the Indian drone, four-string cyclic plucking in a slow steady pattern
- Rich resonant overtone wash with the soft jawari buzz that makes it shimmer
- Deep warm low register with rising harmonic overtones
- No melody, no rhythm, no tabla, no percussion — pure tonal anchor
- 90 unbroken minutes at 432Hz tuning, with a soft theta undertone for meditative depth

⏱ Chapters
0:00    Settling in
20:00   The mind beginning to quiet
45:00   Pure tonal anchor
70:00   Deep stillness
85:00   Quiet close

🧠 How to use:
Sit or lie down somewhere quiet. Set the volume low — just enough to fill the edges of the room. Don't listen for anything. There's no melody to wait for. Let the drone become the background of the silence and let your attention settle into it.

⏱ Best for:
• Silent meditation backing (without guided voice)
• Sitting practice — zazen, vipassana, breath observation
• Sound bath / sound healing sessions
• Mantra repetition (use as drone underneath your own chanting)
• Any moment that needs a tonal anchor with nothing to follow

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min. Drone ships are EXTREMELY forgiving on loop seams since there is no melodic event to disrupt.
production_spec.notes: PURE TANPURA DRONE — fundamentally different from sleep ships. No melodic instrument, no raga exposition, just the tonal anchor. TABLA: NO tabla, NO percussion — rhythm would intrude on the meditative tonal center. Tanpura cycle: Sa-Pa-Sa-Sa (root-fifth-root-root) is the traditional cyclic plucking pattern — slow, steady, hypnotic. Jawari buzz is the SIGNATURE — the bridge resonance that creates the rich overtone shimmer. Without it the drone sounds dead. Theta 5Hz binaural at -20dB — meditation depth (not delta sleep, not alpha awake). LUFS -16 = meditation calm target. Bhairavi tonal key chosen for warm low fundamental — but raga itself doesn't matter since there's no melody. Could be Yaman or Bhairav key — Tanpura is just root + 5th. EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION (one strong metaphor per clip, team reference): clip 1: 'like the inside of a deep bell vibrating into stillness' · clip 2: 'nothing to follow, just something to settle into' · clip 3: 'the room itself becoming the meditation'. STRATEGIC NOTE: Sat dead-day niche filler. Drone meditation audience is small but loyal — production quality should match the niche (deep, immersive, no compromises on the jawari shimmer).
